subject: Draft milestone playbook & reservation economics — next steps
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <psingh@aurelia.health>, Jordan Klein <jk@aurelia.health>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft milestone playbook & reservation economics — next steps

Hi Priya / Jordan,

Thanks again for the POC sync this morning — it was helpful to see the latency and throughput profiles for your transcription pipeline. Attached is a first-pass "milestone playbook" (AH_MAP_v1.pdf) and a lightweight capacity estimate (capacity_estimate_v1.xlsx) that maps the evaluation milestones to reservation sizing and economic levers. High level summary below so we can iterate quickly: 

- Evaluation plan (90 days recommended): 8 reserved A100-equivalent GPUs for the first 30 days for integration + load testing; success criteria = <10% tail latency regressions at 15k tokens/min and inference quality thresholds (WER < 7% on the dev set).
- Ramp & commits: scale from 8 -> 16 by end of month 2 if criteria met, then to 32 by month 4 as traffic ramps.
- Term & pricing: 12-month minimum committal to lock the discounted reserved rate. Base reserved rate proposed: $9.50/hour per A100-equivalent; tiered discounts at 24+ and 48+ GPUs (see attachment).
- Burst policy: temporary +50% capacity for up to 72 hours at a burst multiplier (1.4x base reserved rate). Extended bursts escalate to on-demand pricing or extended-burst surcharge.
- Commercial linkage: each MAP milestone triggers either credits (for evaluation milestones) or release of next tranche of committed capacity and discount tiers.

Questions for you:
1) Is a 90-day eval the right window or would you prefer a shorter paid trial?
2) Are the success criteria above aligned with your SRE/ML goals?
3) Any procurement constraints on PO timing or invoice cadence we should know (net30 vs net45)?

If we can lock the MAP and pricing in the next 10 business days we can target a production-ready handoff by June 15.

I've bcc'ed our draft items in the attachment — please take a look and I can circulate a compact MAP with milestone acceptance checkboxes.

Attachments: [Attachment: AH_MAP_v1.pdf (PDF, 135KB)], [Attachment: capacity_estimate_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB)]

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Priya Singh <psingh@aurelia.health>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Klein <jk@aurelia.health>, procurement@aurelia.health
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft milestone playbook & reservation economics — next steps

Diego — thanks for the write-up and attachments. A few immediate questions from both product and procurement: 

- Burst: +50%/72h at 1.4x sounds reasonable for spikes, but procurement wants a clearer ceiling and a cap on monthly burst charges (they'd like predictability). Can you clarify an explicit monthly burst cap (e.g., no more than 20% of committed spend without prior notice)?
- Trial length: Engineering prefers a shorter commercial risk exposure. Would Redwood consider a 60-day paid eval at a reduced rate (rather than a full 90 days) — we need to minimize upfront spend while proving integration.
- Initial commit: Is it possible to start with 6 GPUs instead of 8 to reduce early cost, with a fast-track increase to 16 if benchmarks pass?
- Security: our security team asked for SOC 2 + access to API audit logs during the eval. Who can own that delivery?

Procurement (procurement@aurelia.health) — copied on this thread for timing/PO requirements. Jordan, do you want to add anything on the perf front?

Thanks,
Priya Singh
Head of ML Platform, Aurelia Health
psingh@aurelia.health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <psingh@aurelia.health>, Jordan Klein <jk@aurelia.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft milestone playbook & reservation economics — next steps

Priya — great notes, thanks. Looping in Marissa (solutions lead) and Ben (pricing & dedicated seats) so we can give concrete alternatives. Quick responses inline + attached MAP v2 that reflects a couple of options: short-eval vs staged commit.

- Monthly burst cap: we can contractually cap automatic burst spend to 20% of committed monthly spend; bursts above that threshold will require a 24-hour notice or explicit PO. We'll show the language in MAP v2.
- Trial length / initial sizing: two alternatives in MAP v2:
  A) 60-day paid eval: 6 reserved GPUs for 60 days at 50% of the committed rate (credit applied to first invoice if you convert to a 12-month commit within 30 days).
  B) 90-day standard eval: 8 GPUs initial, same success criteria, faster ramp path with smaller per-GPU hour rate at conversion.
- Burst multiplier: propose 1.25x for bursts within the cap, and 1.5x beyond cap (to reflect cross-regional allocation).
- Security: Marissa — can your team provide SOC2 package and a sample of the audit logs endpoint for the eval? Priya, we can include a security acceptance milestone in the MAP that gates sign-off on credits.

Target ask: can you review MAP v2 (attached) and indicate preferred path (A or B) by COB Friday, June 3? That keeps us on track for a June 15 prod handoff if the eval completes on schedule.

Attachments: [Attachment: AH_MAP_v2.pdf (PDF, 142KB)]

Thanks,
Diego
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <psingh@aurelia.health>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft milestone playbook & reservation economics — next steps

Priya / team — thanks for the detail. Below is a concise pricing / tranche option you can present to procurement. This is intended to be contractual-friendly and aligns discounts to milestone acceptance.

Option 1 (Conservative starter + convert):
- Initial: 6 reserved A100-equivalent GPUs, 60-day paid eval at 50% of committed unit rate.
- Conversion: if converted to a 12-month reservation within 30 days of eval end, apply a one-time credit equal to 20% of eval spend and lock at $8.25/hr per GPU for months 1–3; pricing steps down to $7.25/hr at 24+ GPUs.
- Burst: within monthly cap (20% of committed spend) = 1.25x multiplier; beyond cap = 1.5x.
- Early termination: 30-day notice plus a pro-rated commitment fee (max 25% of remaining committed term) — this protects capacity planning.

Option 2 (Aggressive ramp):
- Initial: 8 GPUs, 90-day eval, convert to 12-month commit to receive immediate 15% discount off the base rate ($9.50/hr -> $8.08/hr).
- Milestone tranches: each validated milestone (integration, perf, security) releases next tranche and a 5% unit-rate reduction up to 20% total.

Operational notes:
- Credits for eval spend will be applied as a line item on the first invoice after conversion.
- We can include a "burst safe harbor" clause capping automatic billing spikes without written approval.

If this looks reasonable I can have legal draft the SOW + MAP addendum. Diego / Marissa — confirm whether you want the stair-step discount language or a single conversion credit.

Ben Carter
Director, Dedicated Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Priya Singh <psingh@aurelia.health>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Klein <jk@aurelia.health>, procurement@aurelia.health
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft milestone playbook & reservation economics — next steps

Diego / Ben — appreciate the quick turnaround and the explicit options. Procurement and I reviewed the two options this morning and we are inclined to proceed with Option 1 (60-day starter -> convert) with the following clarifications that we'll include in the SOW: 

- Confirmed: 6 GPUs for 60 days at 50% committed rate, credit applied to invoice on conversion (as described).
- Burst: cap automatic bursts to 20% monthly spend; bursts beyond the cap require written approval.
- Security milestone: SOC2 package + access to API audit logs must be available within the first 10 days of the eval (gates 50% of credits).
- Procurement: we will issue an initial PO (net30) for the eval period once legal provides a short MAP addendum.

Please send the SOW / MAP addendum and DocuSign link and we'll route for signatures. We are aiming to complete signatures and PO issuance by June 7 so we can start provisioning on June 15.

Thanks — Priya
